packages.title: Munnar Tea Trails Escape
packages.short_desc: Mist, tea gardens and slow mornings in the Western Ghats.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Arrive Kochi, drive to Munnar, sunset at Top Station. Day 2: Tea museum, Mattupetty dam trek and spice garden visit. Day 3: Kolukkumalai sunrise trek and return to Kochi.
packages.cancellation_terms: Full refund before 7 days; 50% within 7 days.

packages.title: Wayanad Wild & Waterfalls
packages.short_desc: Forests, Edakkal caves and Soochipara falls.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Chembra peak trek and overnight in forest-edge cottage. Day 2: Edakkal caves and Pookode lake boating. Day 3: Morning safari and Soochipara waterfalls.

packages.title: Alleppey Houseboat Slowdown
packages.short_desc: Drift the backwaters on a private kettuvallam houseboat.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Board houseboat at noon, cruise Vembanad lake, sunset anchoring. Day 2: Village canoe tour, toddy-shop lunch stop, night on board. Day 3: Sunrise cruise, disembark after breakfast.

packages.title: Varkala Cliff & Beach Reset
packages.short_desc: Cliff-top yoga, quiet coves and sunset cafes.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Cliff walk and Papanasam beach swim. Day 2: Sunrise yoga, Janardhana temple, cafe hopping. Day 3: Day trip to Kappil backwaters and farewell sunset.

packages.title: Kochi Fort Heritage Walk
packages.short_desc: Chinese nets, synagogues and spice warehouses on foot.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Fort Kochi walk — Chinese fishing nets, St. Francis church, Kathakali show. Day 2: Mattancherry palace, Jew Town, spice market and ferry to Vypeen.

packages.title: Thekkady Spice & Safari
packages.short_desc: Periyar boating safari and spice plantation trails.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Spice plantation walk and Kalaripayattu show. Day 2: Periyar lake boating safari, bamboo rafting option. Day 3: Tribal village visit and departure.

packages.title: Ooty Heritage Toy-Train Trip
packages.short_desc: Nilgiri toy train, botanical gardens and lake picnics.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Toy train Mettupalayam to Ooty, evening lake walk. Day 2: Botanical garden, Doddabetta peak, chocolate factory. Day 3: Pykara lake boating and return.

packages.title: Coorg Coffee Estate Retreat
packages.short_desc: Wake up inside a working coffee estate.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Estate walk and coffee-cupping session. Day 2: Abbey Falls and Raja's Seat sunset. Day 3: Dubare elephant camp and departure.

packages.title: Goa Slow Coast Weekender
packages.short_desc: Beach shacks, flea markets and Portuguese lanes.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Baga beach and Tito's lane evening. Day 2: Fontainhas heritage walk and food trail. Day 3: Palolem kayaking and silent-noise party. Day 4: Anjuna flea market and sunset cruise.

packages.title: Manali Snow Adventure
packages.short_desc: Solang snow sports, paragliding and hot springs.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Arrive Manali, Mall Road evening. Day 2: Solang valley skiing and snow scooter. Day 3: Paragliding and Vashisht hot springs. Day 4: Atal Tunnel excursion to Sissu. Day 5: Old Manali cafes and departure.

packages.title: Jaipur Royal Heritage Rush
packages.short_desc: Forts, bazaars and thalis in the Pink City.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Amber fort and City Palace. Day 2: Hawa Mahal, bazaars and food walk. Day 3: Nahargarh sunrise and Jantar Mantar. Day 4: Albert Hall museum and Chokhi Dhani evening. Day 5: Optional Pushkar day trip.

packages.title: Rishikesh Raft & Yoga
packages.short_desc: White-water rafting by day, Ganga aarti by evening.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Arrive riverside camp, evening Triveni Ghat aarti. Day 2: 16-km rafting stretch and cliff jumping. Day 3: Sunrise yoga, Beatles Ashram visit. Day 4: Bungee option and departure.

packages.title: Andaman Island Hopper
packages.short_desc: Radhanagar sunsets, Ross history and reef snorkelling.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Arrive Port Blair, Cellular Jail light show. Day 2: Ferry to Havelock, Radhanagar beach. Day 3: Elephanta snorkelling trip. Day 4: Neil Island excursion. Day 5: Ross Island history walk. Day 6: Free beach morning and departure.

packages.title: Munnar Budget Homestay Weekend
packages.short_desc: A simple, cheap Munnar escape with a local family.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Arrive, tea-garden stroll with host family. Day 2: Shared jeep to Top Station and Kundala lake.

packages.title: Wayanad Family Nature Camp
packages.short_desc: Easy trails, campfire stories and kid-friendly safaris.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Nature walk and campfire. Day 2: Morning mini-safari, Pookode lake boating and departure.

packages.title: Alleppey Premium Lake Resort
packages.short_desc: Private pool villa facing the Vembanad lagoon.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Check in, lagoon sunset cruise. Day 2: Ayurvedic spa, village tour. Day 3: Houseboat day cruise. Day 4: Checkout brunch and departure.

packages.title: Varkala Surf & Stay
packages.short_desc: Four days of surf lessons and cliff life.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Beach orientation and first surf lesson. Day 2: Two surf sessions and video analysis. Day 3: Free surf, backwater SUP trip. Day 4: Final surf and certification.

packages.title: Coorg Trek Challenge
packages.short_desc: Tadiandamol summit push with camping under stars.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Base camp briefing, acclimatisation walk. Day 2: Tadiandamol summit trek, campfire at high camp.

packages.title: Thekkady Tiger Trail
packages.short_desc: Deep-jungle trekking with ex-poacher guides.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Orientation and spice garden evening. Day 2: Full-day jungle trek. Day 3: Bamboo rafting. Day 4: Border hiking trail and departure.

packages.title: Kochi Food Trail
packages.short_desc: Twelve tastings from toddy shops to Syrian-Christian thalis.

packages.title: Manali Honeymoon Special

packages.itinerary: Day 1: Flower-bedecked arrival, private bonfire. Day 2: Solang snow point excursion. Day 3: Spa couple session, Old Manali walk. Day 4: Naggar castle day trip. Day 5: Checkout and departure.

packages.title: Goa Family Beach Holiday
packages.short_desc: Kid-safe beaches, dolphin trips and waterpark day.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Check in, Benaulim beach evening. Day 2: Dolphin boat trip and waterpark. Day 3: Old Goa churches and river cruise. Day 4: Flea market morning. Day 5: Free beach day and departure.

packages.title: Rishikesh Spiritual Retreat
packages.short_desc: Silent mornings, philosophy talks and sattvic food.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Ashram check-in, orientation, Ganga aarti. Day 2: Yoga, meditation, philosophy talk. Day 3: Sunrise trek to waterfall, closing circle.

packages.title: Andaman Scuba Week
packages.short_desc: Get PADI-certified in the clearest water in India.
packages.itinerary: Day 1: Arrive Havelock, theory session. Day 2: Confined-water training. Day 3: Open-water dives 1–2. Day 4: Open-water dives 3–4 + certification. Day 5: Wreck dive. Day 6: Beach rest. Day 7: Departure.

packages.title: Alleppey Backwater Houseboat Escape
packages.short_desc: A short, affordable houseboat taste of the backwaters.
